requirement.statement: The Eidolon CLI SHALL expose workflow authoring commands that reuse the Eidolon workflow component/service instead of implementing independent workflow core logic.

case.given: a user runs `eidolon workflow init ai-data demo`
case.then: the CLI SHALL obtain the bundle draft from the workflow component and write the returned files under the selected `.eidolon` target root

requirement.statement: Headless Eidolon runtime metadata SHALL include AI workflow roots so native workflow tools can detect workspace/global workflow roots during CLI conversations.

case.given: headless exec runtime metadata is built

requirement.statement: The Eidolon workflow CLI MUST accept explicit heredoc-backed user instructions and MUST continue the same Eidolon conversation across independent CLI processes when a session key is supplied.

case.given: A user invokes `eidolon-cli workflow agent /dev/stdin` or `eidolon-cli workflow agent -` with a shell heredoc
case.when: The workflow agent resolves the requirement
case.then: The complete multi-line stdin body MUST become the ordinary-language request without treating the source token as text

case.given: A user supplies an ordinary single-line requirement positionally
case.when: The workflow agent resolves the requirement
case.then: The original positional behavior MUST remain unchanged and MUST NOT wait for stdin

case.given: A locally installed Eidolon CLI and one stable session key
case.when: three independent heredoc calls create, authorize publication, then authorize execution of a public multi-source workflow
case.then: The CLI MUST recover one Eidolon conversation and return a report grounded in the requested public sources without merging publication and execution authorization
